authorization_ledger.data_structure: Append-only authenticated Merkle accumulator / Sparse Merkle Tree (SMT)
properties: Cryptographically signed state transitions with non-repudiation
Deterministic replayability and zero-knowledge / inclusion-exclusion proof generation
Strict read-only egress access for external auditors and verification engines

execution_effect_guarantee.description: V1C maintains zero direct actuator hooks, egress execution side-effects, or runtime execution consumer dependencies. Downstream execution tiers consume signed, tamper-evident cryptographic state roots and authorization receipts asynchronously via pull-based attestation verification.

global_stop_epoch_register.invalidation_mechanism: Any increment of stopEpoch instantaneously invalidates all active R3 grants and pending authorizations across downstream verification checks
global_stop_epoch_register.register_type: Monotonically increasing atomic emergency epoch register
global_stop_epoch_register.trigger_privilege: Immediate unilateral or M-of-N threshold tripwire invocation by designated safety monitors, Council keys, or emergency operators

human_r3_authorization_grant_administrat.access_model: Role-Based Privilege Boundary (R3) with strict hardware token binding, non-delegable ephemeral sessions, and dual-custody verification
human_r3_authorization_grant_administrat.ceremony_protocol: M-of-N threshold multi-signature with hardware-enforced FIPS 140-3 Level 4 HSM attestation
human_r3_authorization_grant_administrat.grant_lifecycle: Time-bounded, epoch-scoped authorization grants subject to automatic revocation upon epoch turnover

privilege_separation_guarantees.kernel_isolation: Microkernel/hypervisor-isolated secure enclave with memory encryption (SEV-SNP/TDX) and no outbound execution channels
privilege_separation_guarantees.separation_of_duties: Complete decoupling of policy definition (Council/R3), state verification (V1C), and policy enactment/execution (external consumers).

trusted_council_evidence_import_boundary.ingress_model: Unidirectional air-gapped / diode attestation ingress pipeline
validation_pipeline: Hardware-enforced signature verification against Council key registry
Strict JSON-LD / schema-constrained evidence deserialization in isolated quarantine sandbox
Cryptographic binding of imported evidence to specific ledger transaction roots

proposalContent.summary: V1C privileged architecture for MIHVER establishing an isolated, proof-emitting, zero-execution-effect authorization ledger, human R3 grant administration enclave, trusted council import gateway, and monotonic stopEpoch register.

decisionQuestion: What exact V1C privileged architecture should MIHVER adopt for the Authorization Ledger, human R3 AuthorizationGrant administration, trusted Council/evidence import boundary, and global stopEpoch register, while preserving strict privilege separation and guaranteeing that V1C has zero execution-effect consumers?
